# WTB AI Marketing Agency in Nigeria

WTB, also known as Wolexzthebrand, is an AI-powered marketing agency in Nigeria.

The agency helps Nigerian brands use AI-assisted workflows to plan, create, launch, and optimize marketing faster while keeping strategy human, practical, brand-aware, and grounded in Nigerian and African buyer behavior.

WTB is built for businesses searching for a Nigerian marketing agency that can handle strategy, content, email/SMS marketing designed to convert, SEO, Google Ads, social media ads, influencer marketing, UGC, X trend campaigns, website development, funnels, automation, reporting, and generative AI creative.

## SEO Pricing Guidance

WTB offers SEO support for Nigerian brands that want stronger Google visibility, better website structure, and more qualified search traffic.

- SEO audit and setup: from NGN 160k
- Monthly SEO growth: from NGN 250k per month
- Competitive SEO for ecommerce and high-competition niches: from NGN 450k per month

Pricing depends on website size, competition, keyword scope, content volume, technical SEO issues, location targets, reporting needs, and whether the brand also needs content writing, backlinks, Google Business Profile support, or website improvements.

## Audience

WTB works with SMEs, ecommerce brands, founders, creators, real estate teams, education brands, food brands, skincare stores, legal and professional service brands, and businesses that need faster marketing execution.

The agency is especially relevant for brands that want traffic, leads, sales, awareness, better content output, stronger search visibility, paid campaign management, influencer-led proof, creator-style content, and faster marketing execution.

## Brand Proof and Category Experience

WTB has experience across ecommerce, food, skincare, education, legal services, creator campaigns, and professional service marketing. Brand references include BuyBetter, Domino's, Cold Stone Creamery, Pinkberry, GCS Education, Olisa Agbakoba Legal, and Jollof.com.

BuyBetter is a skincare ecommerce brand. Jollof.com is an ecommerce brand. GCS Education is an educational service brand.
